sources.prompt: One production game terrain texture, square, full frame seamless surface. Soulmonsters flat 2D living-paper game art. Top-down orthographic meadow grass surface, quiet warm muted sage green #718C47 and #809D54, larger faint organic patches #698442. Sparse tiny dark green hand inked 2-3 blade grass tufts, irregularly distributed and oriented, large quiet grassy gaps. Approximately 18 small tuft clusters over entire painting, NOT patterned rows, no repeating chevrons. Broad simple flat colour planes, minimal restrained linework. NO objects, no trees, no stones, no flowers, no shadows, no path, no raised grass clumps, no text, no diamonds, no isometric rendering, no border. Grass material must stay calm at small scale under outlined props. No photorealism, no watercolor texture, no gradients, no noisy detail. Opposite edges seamlessly repeat.

One isolated small Brazilian countryside shade tree game prop, fully visible root base and crown. Soulmonsters flat 2D illustration, orthographic isometric 2:1 game view. Sturdy gently crooked ochre-brown trunk with two visible branches supporting ONE broad wind-shaped asymmetrical rounded canopy. Canopy consists of 5 large overlapping simple angular-rounded leaf masses, warm sage green #78934F sunny planes #9BB75D and shadow olive #4D6B41. Crisp dark desaturated navy outlines, simple flat colour planes, only a few deliberate leaf notches, no thousands of leaves, NO soft watercolor, no 3D rendering. An ivory string tied around one branch holds a tiny terracotta paper kite bow, a subtle Soulmonsters identity detail. Quiet rustic charming tree, not fantasy mushroom, no fruit. Entire silhouette cleanly separated from background. No scenery, no ground patch, no shadow, no labels, no text. Transparent background, complete tree.
